about_the_game:
BarbarQ 2 is a lighthearted yet adventure-packed casual action game. Build your own clan, recruit heroes, explore treasure-filled lands, and grow stronger on your journey to becoming the mighty chieftain. The classic 3v3v3 survival brawl makes a powerful return—now enhanced with brand-new PvE modes, PvP events, random encounters, and expanded progression systems that bring this wild world to life!

  • Classic 3v3v3 Mode Returns — Eat Mushrooms, Level Up, Become Master Evil!

    The beloved 3v3v3 chaos is back! Jump into fast-paced six-minute matches with randomly generated abilities. Dodge Bashroom, level up quickly, defeat the boss to become Master Evil, and dominate the battlefield with your team. The familiar brawl experience now feels fresher and even more exhilarating!

  • New Solo “Search–Fight–Evacuate” Mode: Treasure Hunt Begins!

    The all-new PvE & PvP hybrid mode Treasure Hunt is live! Scavenge high-value loot across the battlefield, avoid elite monsters, fight off rivals, and escape at the perfect moment. Successfully extracting your treasure marks a victorious run. It’s thrilling, high-reward, and the newest must-play mode for every chieftain.

  • Mushroom Mayhem Fully Upgraded — New Mechanics, New Terrain, More Mayhem!

    The latest update brings major improvements to Mushroom Mayhem:

    New large-scale core control zone — wider, wilder, and more strategic.

    Tile-collapse & falling-death mechanics — the ground may fall out beneath you at any moment!

    New fun items & talent improvements — smoother pacing and more dynamic combat changes.

  • 13 Heroes Now Available — All Unlockable with Gold!

    A roster of 13 uniquely styled heroes is now open for recruitment:

    BarBarQ, WoWorker, Valvarie, K.K. Lion, Sasatta, BamBamBunny, CocoBear, Kakola, Fufura, GooGooGirl, BarBatty, Momolko, Sosoro.

    Whether you’re a newcomer or a veteran, you can easily recruit your favorite fighters using gold!

  • New Hero Rune System — Power Up to Red-Grade Runes!

    The Rune System has arrived! Mix, match, and enhance freely to create your own strategic build. Rune growth has no hard limits, and the highest tier reaches red-grade runes, offering deep customization and stronger playstyles.

  • New Events Unlocked — Let the Chaos Begin!

    Beyond the core modes, several fun and energetic limited-time events are now available: Captain Hoohook, Golden Shroom Duel, Skyfall Grid Battle More alliance modes and mini-games are on the way, keeping every chieftain entertained even off the battlefield!

  • 10 Random Events Added to Mushroom Mayhem — Every Match Is Unique!

    Random events may trigger mid-battle, making every fight unpredictable:

    “Gold Fency”, “The Party Don’t Stop!”, “Tag-along Shroom”, “Petrification All Around”, “It Collapsed. It Collapsed”, “Puffy Bighead Mushroom”, “Bashroom Duel”, “Shiny Card Battle”, “Bull Assault”, “Falling Durian Star”.

    A delightful mix of chaos and surprises ensures no two battles play the same!

  • Customizable Looks & Hero Development — Back Accessories, Mounts, Pets & More

    Collect stylish back accessories, mounts, and pets to show off your personal flair. Stand out in every match—be the most dazzling chieftain on the battlefield!

  • Build Your Clan & Develop Your Home — Create Your Personal Village

Your clan includes key buildings such as the Doodoo Hut and Wish Shroom Shop. Use resources to upgrade facilities, expand your clan, and develop a home that truly belongs to you.
